tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Live fixed price (EUR, per vehicle, VAT incl.) for a private transfer/chauffeur ride with Airport Transfer Connect — e.g. CDG airport to a Paris hotel. Returns prices for E-Class, V-Class, S-Class, availability and a prefilled booking_url.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check whether a private transfer can be booked for the given route, date/time and number of passengers, and which vehicles fit.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Register a booking request for the passenger (name, email, phone required; only with the user's explicit consent). Returns a reference and a prefilled booking_url where the passenger confirms and pays (card or pay the driver).
